tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. ink, ink-muted, indigo-text, coral-text and velocity-text all pass 4.5:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Frost. Alternating sections, cards, table headers. Same text tokens pass on it.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Hero bands, footer and other dark brand panels inside a light page. Text on it is ink-on-inverse.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Midnight brand block for covers and illustrations; stays distinct from the page in dark mode. Not a text color.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines on surface and surface-subtle (17:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Slate. Supporting copy, captions, metadata on surface and surface-subtle (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: ink-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and midnight (14:1+).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Electric indigo, the primary accent. Fills for the primary button, active states and key highlights. Text on it is on-indigo (5.0:1).

tokens.name: indigo-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for indigo controls (white text 7.0:1).

tokens.name: indigo-text
tokens.usage: Links and indigo text on surface and surface-subtle (6.4:1+ both themes).

tokens.name: on-indigo
tokens.usage: Text and icons on indigo and indigo-hover fills.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Sprocket coral, the signature color. The logo symbol, brand moments, illustration accents. Never a status color and never text on light grounds (2.9:1); on midnight or surface-inverse it reads 6:1.

tokens.name: coral-text
tokens.usage: Coral used as text, such as an eyebrow label, on surface (5.0:1 light, 6.1:1 dark).

tokens.name: velocity
tokens.usage: Velocity mint, the speed signal. Live, real-time and settled indicators, data highlights on dark grounds. Text on it is on-velocity.

tokens.name: velocity-text
tokens.usage: Velocity as text on surface (5.1:1 light, 10:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-velocity
tokens.usage: Text on velocity fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Completed, settled and approved states, as text or icon on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending review, action needed, as text or icon on surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, rejected and error states. Deliberately darker and redder than coral so the two are never confused.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px ring, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, pill padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding, list gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, default gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between related blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop, hero breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels, image frames, brand blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Feature images and app-icon tiles, echoing the symbol's softened corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges and status pills: the brand's buttons are always pills.
